set.body: Follow-up to bd-01M2S5AX3E1E3PRGS3CR322HAX. Binary range searches and memoized hashing qualify 60k samples but the retained 600k workload still has 332-410 ms final steps and 319-362 ms cancellation (docs/evidence/detection-support-final.md). Make EventSeries construction, support/gap validation, labels/reports and remaining provenance work resumable in the recording runner; retain direct execution as the same deterministic drain. Freeze the existing 600k workload and 100 ms target on the documented runtime; test exact result/error equivalence across sample/assembly quanta, cancellation during each assembly phase with no partial result, and pure/JVM/JS boundaries. Report step, runner gap and cancellation independently. No larger envelope or supported-JDK claim without measurement.
set.title: Bound final detection assembly for long recordings
